chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Do not interrupt the request of the beggar, for were it not that the needy sometimes lie, the one who turns them away would not prosper."

key_terms.السَّائِلِ: the one who asks, meaning a beggar or petitioner seeking aid
key_terms.مَسْأَلَتَهُ: his request or petition for help
key_terms.يَرُدُّهُمْ: he turns them away or refuses them
key_terms.يَكْذِبُونَ: they speak falsely or are untruthful

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about responding to beggars and the needy?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches proper conduct toward those who ask for help, forbidding harsh interruption or dismissal of a petitioner. It emphasizes compassion toward the poor and warns that refusing them is spiritually blameworthy, even if some among them may be untruthful.
